claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition E-01 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F02/F04; type EXPLICIT; SUBJECTIVE/GENERAL-WELLNESS; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: MIXED / CONFLICTING. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.claim_text: Premium Grounding boosts energy/alleviates lack of energy.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: H27 direct acute null across fatigue, oxygen uptake, heart rate, lactate and running economy
H22 is 16 participants with many outcomes and one shared cohort

evidence_items.text: Chevalier et al. 2019: small energy and fatigue self-report improvements in 16 massage therapists.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Self-report in a 16-participant stepped wedge that shares its cohort with H21; many outcomes.

evidence_items.text: Muniz-Pardos et al. 2022: randomised crossover in 10 elite male runners found no difference in oxygen uptake, heart rate, lactate, fatigue or running economy (51.1 plus/minus 4.2 versus 50.9 plus/minus 5.1).
evidence_items.why_it_matters: A direct, objective, materially null test of fatigue and functional capacity. Its product is grounded footwear, so the null must not be generalised to all grounding settings.

evidence_items.text: The energy and fatigue construct is inconsistently defined across the evidence; no validated fatigue or energy scale with objective function in a representative population was located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Without a defined metric the claim cannot be reliably tested or verified.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: One small self-report line against a direct objective null, on an undefined construct.
supporting: H22 small self-reported energy and fatigue improvement

detected.rationale: An energy benefit is advertised while the only direct objective test of fatigue and functional capacity was null.
Self-report from 16 occupational participants is extended to the general audience.

audit_trail: confidence classified as VALID (no coercion to 0.0)
2 failure mode(s) echoed from analysis (not inferred)

reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That an energy increase is a demonstrated product effect.
reader_impact.not_a_harm_probability_note: Reader-impact risk is a qualitative category describing how a non-specialist might misread the claim. It is NOT a computed medical, legal, or financial harm probability.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Low-energy complaints are usually benign; the main risk is misplaced purchase reliance rather than clinical harm.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.
recommended_revision.rewrite_verification_note: This rewrite is an UNVERIFIED proposal copied from the analysis input. The numeric-containment guard only checks that it introduces no unsupported number; it does NOT verify factual or semantic accuracy. Its factual support still requires human review.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No specific frozen label applies; the error is asserting an effect on an undefined construct against a direct objective null.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — the Steelman layer correctly discounted the null for product mismatch, but this did not rescue the claim: the remaining support is one small self-report line on an unoperationalised construct.
uncertainty.confidence_caveat: Model's self-assessed probability that its own primary classification is correct (Phase 6.1 semantics). Not a calibrated probability.
missing_evidence: H27 direct acute null across fatigue, oxygen uptake, heart rate, lactate and running economy
H22 is 16 participants with many outcomes and one shared cohort
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: A validated fatigue or energy scale plus objective function in representative users has not been studied.

verdict.classification_note: A forensic classification describes the relationship between the claim and the cited evidence. It is not, by itself, proof that the claim is factually false.
verdict.confidence_interpretation: Model's self-assessed probability that its own primary classification is correct (Phase 6.1 semantics). Not a calibrated probability.
verdict.verdict_summary: 'Energy' has no consistent operational definition in the evidence. The one small positive line is self-report in 16 massage therapists; the one direct objective test found no difference in fatigue, oxygen uptake, heart rate, lactate or running economy.
verdict.verdict_title: Claim goes beyond the available evidence
